object.attr: as implemented: an export reads the document; the PDF isn't document content, so it is neither staged nor committed, and the MCP export tool takes no commit message. MELLON-STORE-SRS-210 says the same for data and figure files; this adds the index, references and other files. Saving pending edits (MELLON-PDF-SRS-12) and the temporary file beside the output (MELLON-PDF-SRS-40) are allowed (review Q25).
object.description: While exporting, Mellon shall change no file in the working copy, the git index or a git reference other than by saving pending edits and writing the exported PDF and its temporary file.
